_comment: Synthetic test vectors (not a roster) for the season-arc window logic and the barometer cohort-validity gate. Pure numeric scenarios, no player identity -- fictional team ids only. Interpreted by ephemeral/2026-08-22-exit-sheet-generator-v1/fixtures_build.py's golden gate (checks.py --gate golden).

coverage_true_pass._comment: All 5 scheduled games stat-bearing and covered via the team's own crawl -- a clean pass, no fallback needed.

coverage_fallback_recovery_pass._comment: v1.2 denominator/fallback rule, live-verified 2026-08-22 against team 1078 (summer 18U): all 44 scheduled games are stat-bearing; g5 (the real 2026-07-26 game) has no own-perspective rows but DOES have this team's player rows under the opponent's perspective_team_id -- recovered via fallback, not excluded. Matches the model's stated '43 covered of 44 listed' PASS.

coverage_true_forfeit_excluded._comment: g5 has NO stat rows anywhere (any team, any perspective) -- this IS the doc's own 'listed-but-uncovered' case (Sec.5 v1.3): a true forfeit/unscored listing, EXCLUDED from the gate's denominator, not counted as a failure.

coverage_genuine_gap_fail._comment: g5 IS stat-bearing (someone crawled it) but this team's players have NO rows for it under ANY perspective -- a real, non-recoverable gap the doc does not separately name (it is NOT the doc's 'listed-but-uncovered', which is the true-forfeit case above). The gate must fail closed here regardless.

arc_window_floor_edge._comment: Sec.4 in-season window floor = 40 PA. Three windows at floor-1/floor/floor+1.

arc_rounding_threshold_crossing._comment: Sec.4 trajectory magnitude for OBP is >=0.080. Endpoint A rounds to 0.333, endpoint B rounds to 0.413 -- a rounded diff of exactly 0.080. The RAW diff (31/75 - 20/60 wouldn't isolate rounding order; these two are picked so raw diff = 0.0796, strictly BELOW 0.080, while the diff-of-ALREADY-ROUNDED-endpoints (the pinned, round-then-diff order this build uses) reads exactly 0.080 and fires. This is the model's 'rounding that would cross a threshold' fixture case, and it pins the build's rounding order as round-each-endpoint-then-diff.

cohort_pass._comment: 8 opponents, evenly weighted (12.5% each, under the 15% cap), all fully covered and fresh -- the gate SHOULD pass.

cohort_dominated_fail._comment: One team is 87% of the pool (>15% cap) -- the gate MUST fail even though the team count clears 8.

cohort_duplicate_identity_fail._comment: The same real club appears under two team ids (measured live condition, 2026-08-22: one opponent present as three team ids) -- dedup must collapse them and the resulting pool (7 after collapse) falls below the 8-team minimum.
